tools.name: understand_info_in_files
tools.description: Understand the content of one or more files (docx/doc/odt/rtf, xlsx/xls/ods/csv, pptx/ppt/odp, pdf both digital-born and scanned, and page images) and write a Markdown answer to output_result_markdown_file_path. Scanned or image-heavy pages are recognised with a local vision OCR model, large documents are paged with a local page selector, and every page keeps its file/page provenance in the output. files_paths: absolute or ~-relative paths. optional_query: what to extract or answer; empty means a complete faithful report. max_output_result_tokens: cap for the answer body (default 65536). Returns the markdown path plus per-file page coverage; read the markdown file after the call.

tools.name: adjust_or_generate_docx
tools.description: Adjust an existing Word document or generate a new one from a demand, writing output_docx_file_path. source_doc_or_docx_file_path may be .docx or .doc (converted internally) or omitted to generate from scratch. any_demand_or_request_or_requirement is the instruction, in any language. pii_protection_mode keeps personal data on this machine while the request is processed. Returns the docx path and the applied operations.

any_demand_or_request_or_requirement.title: Any Demand Or Request Or Requirement

source_doc_or_docx_file_path.title: Source Doc Or Docx File Path

tools.name: legal_lookup
tools.title: Hong Kong and Taiwan legal lookup
tools.description: Answer a question about Hong Kong or Taiwan law by reading official sources. Returns the answer plus citations whose quotes are audited against the fetched official text. Slow by design: expect tens of seconds to a few minutes.

question.description: The legal question, in any language, as specific as possible

jurisdiction.description: hk = Hong Kong SAR, tw = Taiwan, both = answer each system separately

language.description: Language for the answer, for example zh-Hant-HK, zh-Hant, en. Default follows the question

as_of_date.description: Date the law should be stated as at, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today

tools.name: verify_citation
tools.title: Verify a Hong Kong or Taiwan legal citation
tools.description: Check whether a statute or case citation exists in Hong Kong or Taiwan law and says what is claimed, using the official sources. Returns a verdict plus the quoted official text.

citation.description: Citation to verify, for example 'Cap. 57 s 17' or '勞動基準法第36條' or a case name

claim.description: What the citation is claimed to establish, if you want that checked

jurisdiction.description: hk = Hong Kong SAR, tw = Taiwan, both = answer each system separately
